items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: I can have a good tape to send to Bert, to see if he'll make a record of it.

ctx.x: So Henri set it up so that I would be the drummer and that Pierre Michelot (PHONETIC) would be the bassist. So he said well, since Dexter is doing this concert at Espace Cardin, I would like for you to be the drummer and Pierre Michelot -- he's one of the best bass players in Europe, and French, to do this concert, so that I can have a good tape to send to Bert, to see if he'll make a record of it. Now, we just did this this Sunday past, you know.
